## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `e8e2bcbde743f2c8aa6ccb6b871fe2bba30ed711`
Local-runs: none
Scope: declaration face (`Clause-②: yes (widening: @object-ui/i18n gains the public export recordSaveMessage; no accept set moves)`), the whole diff outside the prose faces: ui/packages/i18n/src/recordSaveMessage.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/index.ts, ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectFormContainer.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordFormPage.tsx + the cited code read on the head: ui/packages/i18n/src/useSafeTranslation.ts (`createSafeTranslation` L47), ui/packages/components/src/ui/sonner.tsx L19-53 (`toast` re-export), ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectFormContainer.tsx L118-190 (the drawer and modal schema spreads).

Inputs: card #27453 body and its seven comments (triage 6491491777, devx claim 6499390780 and release 6500073473, retriage ask 6523138910, triage ruling 6523407987 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台」, ui seat 1 claim 6526202454, the os-dev-report); PR #28204 body, 7-file list and the diff against `main` (+348/-52); the check-runs on `e8e2bcbd` (read 2026-10-30T17:04Z): 64 runs over 54 names, all `completed`, 46 `success`, 17 `skipped`, 0 `failure`; the one `cancelled` run is the Check Changeset of 16:45Z superseded by its 16:46–16:48Z re-run on the same head, which is `success`; among the successes Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Lint & Repo Gates, Lint UI, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, the three scoped lints, Type Check UI and · workspace/source/consumer/debt ledger, Test Core, Test UI 1/16-16/16, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Build UI Deps, Dogfood Regression Gate. Author `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, so no login note is owed. The reviewer is not the drafter (`session_01L9qiby8nyBCmFZV9NNymGG`).

### ① Derived judgments

1. `@object-ui/i18n` gains one public export, `recordSaveMessage(t, { label, objectDef, saved, mode })`, and its input type `RecordSaveMessageInput` (`index.ts` L86). It is the one builder of the record-named save message: ADR-0079 display name through `getRecordDisplayName` with the `Record #<id>` floor treated as no name, then `form.createdNamed` / `form.updatedNamed` or the object-label `form.createSuccess` / `form.updateSuccess`. The body is the console's former closure moved verbatim (compared against the deleted `AppContent.tsx` L885-904 and `RecordFormPage.tsx` L199-214 hunks: same resolver, same floor, same four keys). **Right**, a widening of the package's public surface and nothing else; `@object-ui/i18n` already depends on `@object-ui/core`, so no new dependency edge.
2. `@object-ui/app-shell` (`private: true`): `AppContent`'s `recordSaveMessage` and `RecordFormPage`'s `handleSuccess` now call the shared builder; `AppContent` keeps the `t('common.record', { defaultValue: 'Record' })` fallback spelling that `residue-namespaces-3546` pins, and the #27999 warning claim and `toastRecordSave` are untouched. **Right**, a refactor with no wording change (the pinned suites `AppContent.recordSaveToastNamesRecord-26172`, `AppContent.recordSaveOneToast-27999` and the `RecordFormPage.*` files are unchanged and green per the report).
3. `@object-ui/plugin-form`: `ObjectFormContainer`, the container the `object-form` block supplies for `formType: 'drawer' | 'modal'` (ADR-0050 D4), replaces the `onSuccess` it hands `DrawerForm` / `ModalForm` with `handleSuccess` (L145, L184: the spread `...schema` is overridden by the explicit `onSuccess: handleSuccess`, so the author's `onSuccess` is called once, from inside the wrapper, not twice). The wrapper toasts only when the container itself wrote (`dataSource` present, no `submitHandler`, mode `create` or `edit`), uses a declared `successMessage` as written, else the shared builder with the object definition from the adapter's cached `getObjectSchema`, then awaits the author's `onSuccess`. `DrawerForm` / `ModalForm` themselves are unchanged, so direct hosts (the console's record dialog, `useActionModal`, the designer forms) keep their own feedback. **Right**: this is the triage ruling's "platform first" shape with the smallest surface, and no accept set moves (no schema key is added; `successMessage` was already declared and is now read where it was silently ignored).
4. The container's translation falls back to the `en` pack's four keys plus `common.record` through `createSafeTranslation` (L47), so a provider-less host toasts English, not raw keys; `toast` comes from `@object-ui/components`' sonner re-export (L53). **Right.**

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/27453-container-save-toast.md`: `@object-ui/i18n` **patch**, `@object-ui/plugin-form` **patch**; `@object-ui/app-shell` is private and takes none. The `@object-ui/*` group's precedent for a new public export is patch with a `Clause-②: yes (widening: …; no accept set moves)` line (#28151, `@object-ui/react` `unmarkedRefusalLines`, landed 2026-10-30), which this changeset follows. The container's new toast is a behaviour addition on a published renderer with no removed or changed behaviour for a host that owns its feedback. `Clause-②: yes (widening: …)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` sit line-initial on the PR body and the changeset. **Consistent.**

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: none declared.
- Advisory write warnings on the drawer/modal path are not folded into the new toast (the claim lives in `@object-ui/app-shell`, above `plugin-form`): noted, not filed. A drawer save with answer warnings therefore raises two toasts (the success toast here and the write-warning channel's own), which is the pre-change count of warning toasts plus the success toast #27453 asked for. Not a regression; see S1.
- `successMessage` on a drawer/modal block was never shown before and is now the toast: a widening a block author could notice; it is what the key declares.
- Live reproduction against the showcase backend was not run; the behaviour is pinned through the same `ObjectFormContainer` route (13 jsdom cases, ablation 10 red / 3 green). Accepted for a `TIER_DEFAULT` face; the seat's ACCEPT may ask for the showcase smoke.
- Double-toast survey on `e8e2bcbd`: `AppContent` (via `crud_success`), `useActionModal`, `FieldDesigner`, `ObjectManager` mount the forms directly and never pass through the container; the showcase task-desk and renewals pages gain one toast each and raised none before. Read against the diff: holds, and the last test row pins a direct `DrawerForm` mount.
- The card's lane moved `devx` → `ui` by triage 6523407987; `examples/app-showcase` is unchanged, as that ruling asked.
- Author: `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no login note.

Should-fix (none blocks the declaration):
- **S1** File a small `domain:ui` card so the drawer/modal save carries its answer warnings on the success toast as the record page does (`claimAnswerWarnings` would need a home below app-shell, or the container could accept a claim). Until then a warned drawer save shows two toasts.

Tests `containerSaveToastNamesRecord-27453.test.tsx` (13 cases, ablation 10 red / 3 green) and a root changeset (i18n, plugin-form patch).
2. **Seat read:** there's no double toast. `AppContent`, `useActionModal`, `FieldDesigner` and `ObjectManager` mount `ModalForm` / `DrawerForm` directly and never pass through the container; the showcase task-desk and renewals pages gain one toast each and raised none of their own before (survey in the PR body, last test row pins a direct `DrawerForm` mount). `examples/**` and `packages/spec/**` are untouched.

Its one should-fix S1 (a warned drawer/modal save shows the warning as a second toast instead of riding the success toast) is filed as #28216, serial after this PR.
